title: Brand Identity Design Dubai: Logo and Identity | The Brandle
description: Brand identity design in Dubai. Logo, colour, type and guidelines, delivered as a full file kit that you own outright. Fixed quote before work starts.

hub.name: Brand identity
hub.line: Logo, colour, type and the rules that hold them together.

hero.joke: A logo is not a brand. It's a good start, though, and yours could use one.
hero.intro: Brand identity design in Dubai for businesses that look smaller than they are. Logo, colour, typography and the rules that hold them together, delivered as a complete kit you own. Fixed quote before we start.

items.p: Who you're for, who you're up against and what you'd like people to say about you. All before any drawing.
A small number of considered directions, then one refined properly. Including the tiny versions for browser tabs and app icons.
A palette and typefaces chosen to work on a phone screen, a shopfront and an invoice.
A short document showing how to use it all. Written for the person who'll really open it, usually a printer in a hurry.
Business cards, social templates, email signatures, packaging or signage. Whatever your business actually touches.
Every logo in every format, plus colours and type set up for whoever builds the site. Ideally us.

fit.p: You can tell when it's time. The logo exists in five versions, none of them sharp. The website and the business card look like different companies. People are surprised when they meet you, in the wrong direction.
yes: Launching something new with no identity yet
Selling something your current brand doesn't suggest
Juggling five versions of your own logo
About to pay for a website, a shopfront or packaging
fit.no: you only need a quick logo for a side project. A full identity is more than that deserves. And if it's the product that confuses people, start with [UI/UX design](/services/ui-ux-design/).

items.p: A free call and a short questionnaire about the business, the customers and the competition. A fixed quote follows.
A few distinct directions, shown on real things like a sign or a screen. Not floating on a white page.
You pick one. We develop it across colour, type and layouts until it holds together.
Guidelines and the full file kit, source files included. It's yours on final payment.

price.p: A logo and core palette is a different job from a full identity with guidelines and packaging, so we scope first and quote a fixed price. Budgeting for a site too? Our website [plans](/pricing/) run from $1,299 to $6,499.

faq.q: Do I own the logo and files?
faq.a: Yes. On final payment the identity is yours outright, with every source and export file, including the editable originals.

faq.q: How many logo concepts do I get?
faq.a: A small number of directions, each one we'd be happy to defend. Twenty options isn't generosity. It's a designer who couldn't decide.

faq.q: Can you design the brand and build the website?
faq.a: Yes, and it usually goes better. The identity gets designed knowing where it has to live, and nobody has to explain the brand to a second team.

faq.q: How do I choose a branding agency?
faq.a: Check whether their work for different clients looks different. Ask who does the design. Our longer list is in [how to choose a branding agency](/blog/branding-agency/), and it applies to us too.

post.title: How to choose a branding agency wisely

cta.p: Tell us about the business and send the logo you have, however bad. We've seen worse.
